stem: A lower-cost product is listed as interchangeable and reasonably available. Select all facts that matter before substitution.

choices.text: Determine whether the prescriber validly indicated no substitution.
Substitute any same-class drug without checking the list.
Confirm the product is listed as interchangeable under Massachusetts standards.
Treat therapeutic similarity alone as legal interchangeability.

explanation.core_reasoning: Apply each proposition independently. A pharmacist dispenses a less expensive reasonably available interchangeable product listed under Massachusetts standards unless the prescriber validly indicates no substitution or another exception applies.

choice_analysis.C: The proposition 'Confirm the product is listed as interchangeable under Massachusetts standards.' is supported by Massachusetts interchangeable-drug dispensing: A pharmacist dispenses a less expensive reasonably available interchangeable product listed under Massachusetts standards unless the prescriber validly indicates no substitution or another exception applies.
choice_analysis.D: This statement imports Massachusetts Schedule VI prescription-drug status without its required trigger and is not supported by the scenario.
choice_analysis.E: This statement imports Schedule II partial fill caused by pharmacy inability without its required trigger and is not supported by the scenario.
